targets.warmup: Every day requires 200 contiguous finite positive completed daily closes for all five assets, and 30 past daily returns for covariance. 2024-Jan-1 needs 2023-Jun-16 through 2024-Jan-1 close-availability clocks inclusive. Missing is UNKNOWN, never silent CASH. Same source cube is bit-identical to Y2023 on all 2023-Jun-16 onward overlapping closes.
targets.CS_MATCHED: Canonical public_targets fixed weekly anchor 1704067200000000 us, 21-day relative-return top2 long/bottom2 short, raw gross .6, daily original downscale-only covariance risk; then original common=min(.10, CS sigma, HOLD sigma) downscale. Risk-budget scale below applies after this matching.
targets.VOL_MATCHED: Original VOL_MANAGED_HOLD unconditionally long, base .6/K eligible (K=5), original signed_risk_weights downscale-only annual .10 from past30 sample returns; then same common matched downscale. Risk-budget scale below applies after this matching.
targets.STATIC50: Apply original portfolio-risk-budget scale to .5*old common-risk-matched CS + .5*old common-risk-matched HOLD, from a fresh original current-period target. This can scale UP to .10 forecast risk subject to .3 asset/.6 gross caps; do not replace with .5 of final post-budget CS and HOLD.
targets.CS_VOL_risk_budget: Apply original portfolio-risk-budget scale separately to each old matched CS and HOLD, with same past30 sample covariance ddof1 annual365, .10 nominal annual forecast risk, .3 absolute asset and .6 gross caps. Cap shortfall preserved and reported; no claim of exact all-day matched realized risk.
targets.SMA200_10PCT: Original main signed_intents SMA column zero: pandas rolling200(min_periods200) completed-close mean including current available close; sign(current-mean); base .6/K all eligible assets including zero-direction members; original signed_risk_weights past30 sample covariance annual365 downscale only. Do not substitute the common-risk rescaled agreement-experiment SMA.
targets.EXACTHALF: Literal .5*STATIC50 + .5*SMA200_10PCT on identical ordered dates/assets, no subsequent risk scaling. Signed opposing positions algebraically cancel to genuine cash. Both component .3/.6 caps carry by convexity.

regression: Before 2024 target generation, targets_2024.py must reproduce 2023 and 2025 original saved CS_MATCHED/VOL_MATCHED/STATIC50/SMA200_10PCT matrices and covariance bit-for-bit from SHA-pinned original daily cubes and original saved target bytes. Previous observed results do not select any new target rule.

comparison: Five same-calendar native wallets, whole366-day net and marked/paid distinction, realized daily volatility, observed-minute maximum drawdown, worst 30 days, price/funding/cost breakdown, turnover/exposure, liquidation/stop events, and independently reconciled inventory/NAV. Paired same-date 14-calendar-day circular bootstrap 1000 draws with seed 811764 for EXACTHALF minus each other arm; descriptive, not research-selection-adjusted. Compare 2023/2025 results only as separate previously seen episodes, never stitch accounts or annualize single favorable segments.
gates: Source/checksum/derived-overlay allowlist, 366 target and owned-minute calendar, full accounting/inventory audit and actual terminal status are reported separately from performance. Preserve failures; do not shorten 2024 or tune after observing results. Positive net, <=12% observed-minute maximum drawdown, no liquidation and paid terminal flat are disclosed as fixed descriptive qualification gates, not permission for deployment.
